name: DARBF Backpropagation
definition: The process of computing gradients for Decaying Anisotropic Radial Basis Functions (DARBFs) during backpropagation, modifying the standard differentiable Gaussian rasterizer to support specific DARBF gradient terms.
summary: DARBF Backpropagation computes gradients for Decaying Anisotropic Radial Basis Functions by replacing standard Gaussian derivatives with chain-rule expansions tailored to specific activation functions like half-cosine.
